errors.text: The disappearance of the smallest particles is attributed primarily to Ostwald ripening and redeposition, whereas the target mechanism is Au/Cu surface segregation followed by melting and evaporation under vacuum.
The predicted shape evolution from spherical to faceted or irregular particles conflicts with the observed elliptical-to-spherical reshaping.
The proposed greater-than-50 nm boundary for recovery of sluggish diffusion is unsupported by either the supplied evidence or a direct measurement.
